description:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

As the leader of the Supply Performance function, you will sit at the intersections of analytics, business strategy, sales & client management, AI adoption, and operational execution. Reporting to the Vice President, Supply Operations, you will be responsible for directly supporting both our sales and post-sales teams on everything from deal strategy and modeling, offer design, offer communication & negotiation, deal performance measurement, target setting & measurement, revenue optimization, and issue resolution.  You will work cross functionally with our Finance, Legal, and Analytical functions as well as our Executive Team.  You will have a strong voice across our Supply organization, will serve as an example for how work gets done, and be a strategic partner to Supply leadership.

An individual in this role must have a unique mix of analytical, strategic, and communication skills combined with a competitive drive, eagerness to learn, collaborative mindset, and the energy to work in a fast paced market disruptor. This individual should see AI as a core part of how modern analytical work gets done, and be eager to help shape how our Supply team uses it.

What you'll do

Deal Desk

  • Collaborate with sales, client success, finance, and supply leadership on offer strategy and design
  • Lead prioritization and strategic feedback for deal modeling across both new business and renewals, using AI tools to speed up scenario analysis and stress test assumptions
  • Support Finance on the creation of new deal models for our most complex new business and renewal deals
  • Become a trusted advisor to sales and client success on negotiating deals, including taking a live prospect and client facing role where needed
  • Lead internal process for deal communication and executive approvals
  • Use AI to synthesize deal history, contract terms, and benchmarks so offer recommendations can be built faster and with more context

Target Setting and Performance Tracking 

  • Partner with our existing business leaders on strategy definition and the metrics that will support it
  • Design and set both annual, semi-annual, and quarterly targets across both new business bookings and existing client revenue
  • Develop and advance performance tracking against identified KPI’s including, including AI-assisted reporting that surfaces trends, anomalies, and narrative summaries for stakeholders
  • Track deal performance vs models and lead a feedback loop to continually improve our offer construction and modeling process

Performance Optimization

  • Provide strategic insight framing for key existing business executive updates
  • Identify insights and high level needle movers across the portfolio to achieve company objectives including incremental revenue and client satisfaction
  • Work cross functionally to identify, develop, and execute action plans to capitalize on identified insights
  • Educate and enable existing business teams on identified insights and paths to improvement
  • Automate, optimize and ensure accuracy and quality of outputs, finding chances to use AI and automation to remove manual work and scale the team’s impact
  • Apply sound judgment to AI-generated outputs: validate results, understand limitations, and keep high standards for accuracy in executive-facing work

What you have

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in business operations, sales strategy, analytics, or consulting
  • Mastery of Excel and/or Google Sheets; experience working with complicated financial models to drive decision making
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude) to accelerate analysis, modeling, and a demonstrated drive to learn and apply them quickly
  • Experience collaborating with senior, C-level executives to construct / present proposals, answer questions, and drive approvals
  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • Ability to analyze complex or ambiguous situations and data sets and derive workable actions
  • Experience pulling insights out of large data sets, preferably using BI visualization tools is a plus
  • Prospect or client facing experience is a plus
  • Experience managing small teams is a plus
  • MBA is a plus
  • Ability to work well with other personalities - you’re a low ego team player
  • An entrepreneurial mentality who gets things done through exceptional collaboration
  • Comfortable moving fast with imperfect information
  • Critical thinking skills, asks great questions, while designing / proposing solutions
  • A hungry learner & patient teacher
  • Values a strong team, feedback and career development

Perks

  • Equity stake
  • Discretionary annual bonus
  • Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely
  • A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave 
  • 401(k) matching 
  • Student loan matching program
  • Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
  • Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care
  • $500 per year for wellness expenses
  • Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
  • $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
  • Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

 

The salary range for this role is $102,000 - $147,000 USD. This role is equity eligible. In addition, you may receive a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation packages within that range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location.

SeatGeek is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, creed, age, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. As an equal opportunities employer, we recognize that diversity is a positive attribute and we welcome the differences and benefits that a diverse culture brings. Come join us!
